description: This file defines the ColumnClusteredPlotAreaRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering a clustered column chart plot area in the PdfSharp.Charting library. It calculates column positions and sizes, and determines if data points are within the visible range.

classes.name: ColumnClusteredPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for clustered column chart plot areas that draws columns side by side for each series.

methods.name: CalcColumns
methods.description: Calculates the position, width, and height of each column for all series in the clustered column chart.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Checks whether a given y-value falls within the defined y-axis range.
